Drifloon

Ghost Flying

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Drifloon is a Ghost/Flying-type Balloon Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 1.2 kg. It evolves into Drifblim. Its highest base stat is HP (90), with a base stat total of 348.
